notes.title: Sound Slide update - Sync problems are fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

We are very glad to see that many people are interested in the game, and that most of the feedbacks about the game are positive ones. 

On the other hand, we received complains about sync problems, indeed some players had really strong delays between sound and levels. These negative feedbacks were legit, and we worked hard the last couple of days to fix the sync problems.

So there it is! These problems are now fixed with the new update, and everyone should enjoy the game, regardless of their setup. 

Thank you all,
Bye,
Smoohty & the Sound Slide team.
